title: Weekly Email Digest Preference in Notification Settings
purpose: Enable members to control whether they receive weekly email digests from notification settings, with the setting persisting across sessions and not affecting account-security messages.

scope.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: As a member, I want to turn weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member is in notification settings, when the member turns weekly email digests on, then the setting reflects that digests are on.
Given a member is in notification settings, when the member turns weekly email digests off, then the setting reflects that digests are off.

stories.text: As a member, I want my weekly email digest setting to persist after signing out and signing back in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has turned weekly email digests on, when the member signs out and signs back in, then weekly email digests remain on.
Given a member has turned weekly email digests off, when the member signs out and signs back in, then weekly email digests remain off.

stories.text: As a member, I want account-security messages to continue even when I switch weekly email digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has weekly email digests off, when an account-security message is generated, then the account-security message is not disabled by the digest setting.

stories.text: As a newly created member, I want my weekly email digests to start off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member account is newly created, when the member views notification settings, then weekly email digests are off.

edge_cases.text: A member who has never changed the setting and is not newly created may have inherited a state; the intended default for such accounts is not stated.
Whether switching digests off should suppress already-queued digest messages is not stated.

dependencies.text: Notification settings must exist as a member-accessible location; no owner or implementation dependency is stated.
An account-security messaging path is assumed to exist separately from weekly digests, but this dependency is not confirmed by the source.

risks.text: Without a defined list of which messages count as account-security messages, a change to digest handling could unintentionally affect them.

success_metrics.text: Verify that a member can change the weekly email digest setting and that the chosen value is shown after signing out and back in.
Verify that a newly created member account shows weekly email digests off.

open_questions: Who owns the delivery of this change, and by what date?
What is the exact set of messages that count as account-security messages, so that they remain unaffected by switching digests off?
For existing members who are not newly created, what should the initial digest state be if the setting has never been changed?
Should switching weekly email digests off suppress digests already queued for delivery, or only future digests?
